newsitem.title: ANTIGUA: CRICKET-SRI LANKA TO PLAY AT NEW CARIBBEAN TEST VENUE.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SRI LANKA TO PLAY AT NEW CARIBBEAN TEST VENUE.

text.p: Test cricket is to be played at Kingstown, St Vincent, for the first time when Sri Lanka tour West Indies starting in late May.
The Arnos Vale ground in Kingstown, which has already staged one-day internationals, hosts the second test of Sri Lanka's first-ever tour of the Caribbean, from June 13-17.
The itinerary for the short visit released by West Indies Cricket Board of Control (WICBC) also includes one limited overs international.
West Indies and Sri Lanka have met once previously at test level, in a rain-hit drawn match in Sri Lanka at the end of 1993.
May 28 Trinidad and Tobago, Port of Spain
May 30 One-day international, Port of Spain
June 1-3 Leeward Islands, St John's, Antigua
June 6-10 First test, St John's, Antigua
June 13-17 Second test, Kingstown, St Vincent
